digest.component_or_area: test suite: Jira DataCenter transport and pagination
propositions: Five tests have assertions that logically cannot fail: test_the_pat_never_appears_in_the_repr_of_the_transport (PAT never reaches constructor), test_the_structural_guard_fires_on_a_synthetic_unpaginated_caller (re-implements AST walk instead of calling shared predicate), test_validate_assignee_exists_returns_the_dc_username (only asserts hasattr, already tested elsewhere), the rate-limit enumeration sweep (asserts total <= 1 instead of == 1, satisfying 0), and test_an_unknown_backend_raises_the_registry_error_not_key_error (never calls select_backend).
The PAT repr test must construct a transport that actually holds a credential and assert the credential value is absent from repr().

The pagination guard's shared predicate _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default() must accept an optional source parameter so the teeth test can pass a synthetic unpaginated example, eliminating code duplication.
The validate_assignee_exists tests must assert the actual return value is a username string (DC) or account ID (Cloud), not a bool or mere presence.
The rate-limit test must assert total == 1 per member and catch BackendHTTPError with .code == 429, not a blanket Exception with total <= 1.

The unknown-backend test must actually call select_backend with a known key (positive control) and then with an unknown key (negative case asserting BackendRegistryError), not just verify a class relationship.
